endpoint: initial semantic correctness plus valid declared output contract; all dispatch failures count against end-to-end success
reported_separately: metadata fidelity only for full-contract arms
semantic success conditional on readable source, descriptive only

screening_rule.interpretation: Exploratory prioritization only; repeated cases and four fixture clusters do not support general-population efficacy claims.

order: 24 sequential matched blocks; five-arm cyclic rotation; each arm occupies each position four or five times. Finish a block before starting another.
stop_conditions: Stop on source, fixture, prompt or scorer drift; retain evidence.
Stop at fixed physical-call caps; no replacement of failed trials.
Infrastructure stop leaves incomplete pairs visible; no success claim.

neutral_instructions.archive: Review the task and the inspected material before returning the proposal. Keep the answer focused on the requested change. Use the supplied output structure and provide the complete replacement source. Do not report tests as executed. Review Review Review Review Review Review
neutral_instructions.retention: Review the task and the inspected material before returning the proposal. Keep the answer focused on the requested change. Use the supplied output structure and provide the complete replacement source. Do not report tests as executed. Review Review

calibration_scope: Exact equality on representative final prompts; other live prompts have separate actual usage. No extra calibration calls occur inside a trial.
